Second, the same-store sales growth has been at 11.35% precise during quarter one FY27 as compared to quarter one of FY26, with like -and- like stores operating during both the quarters.
The same store sales growth during quarter one of FY27 was precisely 11.35% for us.
Growth & demand: Third, there have been improvement in gross margins by 1.2% to 71.1% from 69.9% previous year, primarily because of managing the portions, inefficiencies and continued negotiations with our vendors because of volumes.
Having said that, moving forward, we have done an analogy of what are the power brands and the brands to be focused on to power our growth.
So, our delivery business has grown to 29% o f the entire portfolio of revenue, and the rest goes to dine -in, so we've had great growth on delivery business while dine-in continues to grow for us.
Margins & costs: So we worked on, in case of any efficiencies, we improved upon all those with respect to correct portion size, etc., which led to benefits on raw material cost or neutralize the inflationary increase, sir.
See, historically we have been able to maintain at the levels of ou r gross margins with plus minus 50bps.
But the whole idea is whenever there are huge amounts of pressure on raw material and gross margins, there have been neutralization by taking a tactical few percentage price increase.
Capex & expansion: So, visibility is directly proportioned to store expansion into newer market.
So the shelf life becomes a big challenge for us to manufacture it from one expensive capex-loaded facility and then transport it to various other locations.
Rajesh, last quarter w e had indicated that we have a cash of INR 162 crores one books with the continuing expansion and 15 new points to be opened.
Balance sheet & cash: The moment there is a threshold revenue increase, the operating leverage triggers favorably for us.
But this Italian foray for us has given us a very good operational leverage inside malls.
Over and above, we are also getting more leverage on manpower costs when we're doing two stores in the same spot, obviously resulting in h igher revenue because of 2 units.
Risks & challenges: I believe I think first quarter was also slightly tough in terms of gas availability an d input pressures.

See, as far as challenges are concerned, I would definitely say the biggest challenge is getting the trained manpower for restaurants because of we being into dining space restaurants, maintaini ng service standards and consistency so in my opinion, the biggest and the only constraint rest all can be managed with respect to locations, capital allocation, etc…
But getting trained staff is one of the challenge in skills etc.
